entities.summary: Brynjar Aa often Brynjar Å is a Norwegian dramatist. He was born in Trondheim. He was a student at the Telemark University College and studied under Norwegian writer Eldrid Lunden. Before finishing at Bø, Aa published the book Babyboy.
